header.title: Component shortages, especially memory, lift AI server rack ASPs and revenue

s01_bottom_line.text: Shortages and rising prices of key components, particularly memory, are driving up AI server rack ASPs, helping AI server revenue surge over 90% to nearly $920bn in 2027 (about 81% of a server market exceeding $1 trillion). ⟨cited figures: forecast; approximate⟩
The article attributes rising AI server revenue and ASPs to component shortages and rising prices, particularly memory. ⟨cited figures: forecast; approximate⟩

Rising ASPs driven by component shortages mean AI server revenue growth outpaces unit shipment growth, benefiting component suppliers with pricing power, though the article names no specific memory supplier.
